meta.title: Request free green coffee samples | Origins
meta.description: Request a free 200 g sample of Colombian green coffee from family farms in Urrao. Cup it in your own lab, then buy by the 35 kg box. No obligation.

banner.title: Request free green coffee
banner.description: Tell us where to send it and which lot you want. We ship from Colombia.

aside.title: Cup it before
aside.text: A sample is how you decide. Pick a lot, or tell us what your menu needs and we will suggest a closer match.

steps.title: Send the form
steps.text: Your name, roastery and where the sample should arrive.

steps.title: We ship from Colombia
steps.text: We confirm the lot and tell you when the parcel leaves.

steps.title: You cup and decide
steps.text: Tell us what you think. If the lot is right, we quote the 35 kg box.

aside.orWhatsApp: Prefer to talk? Message us on WhatsApp.
aside.whatsappMessage: Hello, I would like to request a sample of green coffee.

form.title: Where should we send it?
form.name: Your name
form.lotHint: You can ask for a different lot in the message.
form.volume: How much green coffee do you buy per month?
form.addressHint: Street, city, postal code and country. A phone number helps the courier.
form.messageHint: For example the flavors you look for or the machine you roast on.

success.title: Thank you, your request is in.
success.text: We will confirm the lot and the shipping details by email. If a lot is no longer available, we will suggest a close match.

banner.title: Talk to the people
banner.description: Write in English or Spanish. We read every message.

channels.title: Reach us

form.title: Or send a message
form.name: Your name

success.title: Message sent, thank you.
success.text: We will answer by email. For anything urgent, write to us on WhatsApp.

meta.title: Sell your coffee with us | Colombian Coffee Origins
meta.description: Sell your coffee with Colombian Coffee Origins: list green lots for roasters worldwide, or roasted bags in our Colombia shop. See the requirements and apply.

banner.title: Sell your coffee
banner.description: List your lot under your own name, farm and town. Two ways to sell, one application.

ways.title: Two ways
ways.text: Choose one or both. Each line has its own buyers, currency and rules.

green.title: Green coffee lots
green.text: Roasters and importers buy your lot by the box, priced in USD per kg (FOB). Your name, farm, altitude, variety, process and cupping score sit on every card.
points: Samples sent to buyers from Colombia

roasted.title: Roasted bags
roasted.text: Bags roasted and packed by you, sold in our Colombian shop in COP and delivered inside the country. Your brand stays on the bag.
points: Whole bean bags with your brand and roast level
Priced in COP, with price per kg shown
Orders arrive by WhatsApp for now

requirements.title: What we
requirements.text: Short and practical. We check each one before a lot goes live, and say so on the page.

items.title: A real coffee farm
items.text: A farm or cooperative in Colombia, with a named producer and town.

items.title: A traceable lot
items.text: Harvest, variety and process you can state, and enough coffee for at least one box.

items.title: A sample we can cup
items.text: We cup it ourselves and publish the score. No score, no invented numbers.

items.title: Your name on the page
items.text: Producer, farm and town are public, and so are the photos you share.

items.title: For roasted bags
items.text: The sanitary registration Colombian law asks for roasted coffee. We explain it on the first call.

form.title: Tell us about your coffee
form.text: This is a first conversation, not a contract.
form.name: Your name
form.way: How do you want to sell?
form.volume: Coffee you could offer per harvest
form.volumeHint: A rough number in kg is enough.
form.messageHint: Varieties, altitude, process, certifications and anything you are proud of.

success.title: Thank you, we received your application.
success.text: We will write to you to arrange a sample and a call. Nothing is published until you agree.
